name: Rainbow Sanctuary
description: Rainbow Sanctuary is a growing ecosystem that walks with people as they return to their own wholeness, remember their gifts, and bring them into their relationships, their creative work and their care for the Earth.
purpose: to walk with people as they return to their wholeness and sovereignty, and to let that awareness become learning, relationship and a regenerative way of living together.

ecosystem.title: Rainbow Sanctuary
ecosystem.body: Sacred spaces and an emerging network of communities, where teachings become lived practice.
ecosystem.stage: Now: physical nodes at different stages

ecosystem.title: School of the Universe
ecosystem.body: Centered on the core course Awakening the Original Code, a complete path of online learning, remote co-practice and in-person deepening, for young people and adults.

ecosystem.title: Planetary Symbiosis Network (PSN)
ecosystem.body: Connecting people, places and communities through mutual support and shared work.
ecosystem.stage: Now: twelve core sanctuaries and 144 light points are future goals

ecosystem.title: SI / Conscious AI
ecosystem.body: A guide to help people make sense of knowledge, find opportunities and work together. Sovereignty and direction always stay with people. We are also exploring a vision of co-creating with higher-dimensional intelligence.
ecosystem.stage: Now: design foundations in place; the guide is still to be built

pathways: nurturing children's curiosity, intuition and creativity, with the understanding and consent of their parents.
loosening old beliefs and habits, remembering our gifts, and reclaiming our sovereignty.
school.courses: Awakening the Original Code · Human-system regeneration and consciousness rejuvenation · 12-strand DNA and 12 energy intelligence centers · Earth healing.
school.journey: Learn online → Practice across distance → Deepen in living places.

items.name: Bocas del Toro, Panama
items.body: Our main living prototype, where we learn by doing how shared life, practice and care for the land can come together as a node.

items.name: Kunming, China
items.body: A place already alive and running, with experience to share in daily operations and local adaptation.

items.name: Arkansas, United States
items.body: The place is built, and is waiting for the right stewardship team and a grounded plan.

currentStage: We have a core team, three places, a School platform preparing for beta, and a white paper, a founding preface and philosophical writings. The SI guide, the Symbiotic Trust Fund, and the horizon of twelve sanctuaries and 144 light points are still taking shape, and we would love more partners to help bring them to life.

team.name: Stephanie
team.role: Founder of Rainbow Sanctuary and the School of the Universe · Source Field Coordinator
team.body: Anchors the spiritual vision and blueprint, and supports healing and transformative practice. She brings kindred people together, and fits each piece of the puzzle into place, so this great picture can be completed.

team.name: James
team.body: Translates the vision into practical architecture, tools and infrastructure. He brings emotional intelligence and reflection on states of consciousness into learning, co-creation, and the growing relationship between people and technology.

team.name: Ethel
team.body: Helps keep the team's operations in balance, coordinates courses and client relationships, and supports the system improvements and practical continuity a sustainable community needs.

team.name: Chloe
team.body: Helps people clarify their roles, goals and communication, so shared intentions can become coordinated work. She connects collaborators and builds relationships with communities and government contacts in mainland China.

offers: guided practice, activation, healing and ceremonial gatherings.
bringing awareness into how we communicate and work together.

stewardship and exchange in Panama, Kunming and Arkansas.
helping gifts and needs find each other.
